initial.README.md:
# @@NAME@@ · status board

A small dashboard that shows the health of the services running on **@@VM@@**.

## Stack

- `src/` — Vite + TypeScript front end (no framework, ~400 lines)
- `server/` — Go health API (`GET /api/health`, `GET /api/services`)
- `scripts/seed.py` — fills the local SQLite file with sample services

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm run dev          # front end on http://localhost:5173
go run ./server      # API on http://localhost:8080
python scripts/seed.py
```

## Layout

| Path                     | What                         |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------- |
| src/main.ts              | entry, mounts the board      |
| src/api/client.ts        | typed fetch wrapper          |
| src/components/          | status cards                 |
| src/styles/app.css       | design tokens + layout       |

> Tip: Ctrl+P opens any file, Ctrl+Alt+F searches the whole project.

initial.scripts/seed.py:
"""Fill status.db with a few sample services (for local development)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import random
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

DB = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "status.db"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Service:
    id: str
    name: str
    status: str
    latency_ms: float


SAMPLE = [
    Service("web", "Web front end", "up", 42.0),
    Service("api", "Status API", "up", 18.5),
    Service("worker", "Queue worker", "degraded", 730.0),
    Service("db", "PostgreSQL", "up", 3.2),
]


def main() -> None:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    con.execute(
        "create table if not exists services ("
        " id text primary key, name text, status text, latency_ms real, checked_at text)"
    )
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    for s in SAMPLE:
        checked = now - timedelta(seconds=random.randint(1, 90))
        con.execute(
            "insert or replace into services values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (s.id, s.name, s.status, s.latency_ms, checked.isoformat()),
        )
    con.commit()
    print(f"seeded {len(SAMPLE)} services into {DB.name}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
